info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to pray, to honor, to worship, to respect

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' pUjAyAM RO viBAzArce: arcayatyarcatercati . BUvAdO pAWasAmarTyAt kartugAmiPalercati ' (Slo.49) iti devaH . ayamAtmanepadIti SAkawAyanaH . ' aca ityeke ' iti ABaraRoktiH .

examples: 'arcata prArcata priyameDAso arcata' (f॰8.69.8). praSabdaH prakarze. prArcata BUyaH pUjayatetyarTaH.
'ima u tvA puruSAka prayajyo jaritAro aByarcantyarkEH' (f0 6.21.10). aByarcanti pUjayanti. aBirnArTentaraM karoti.
'agne yatte'rcistena tampratyarca yo'smAn dvezwi' (aTarva0 2.19.3). taM pratyarca taM dagDuM dIpyasvetyarTaH.
